lines.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.r: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
lines.ht: ੴ सति नामु करता पुरखु निरभउ निरवैरु अकाल मूरति अजूनी सैभं गुर प्रसादि ॥
lines.e: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~
Name of the Composition, "Jup". Chant And Meditate:
True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

lines.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.r: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach ||1||
lines.ht: है भी सचु नानक होसी भी सचु ॥१॥
lines.e: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

lines.g: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.r: sochai soch na hoviee je sochee lakh vaar ||
lines.ht: सोचै सोचि न होवई जे सोची लख वार ॥
lines.e: Even if one bathes hundreds of thousands of times, the mind does not become cleansed.

lines.g: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.r: chupai chup na hoviee je lai rahaa liv taar ||
lines.ht: चुपै चुप न होवई जे लाइ रहा लिव तार ॥
lines.e: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

lines.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.r: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||
lines.ht: भुखिआ भुख न उतरी जे बंना पुरीआ भार ॥
lines.e: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

lines.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.r: sahas siaanapaa lakh hoh ta ik na chalai naal ||
lines.ht: सहस सिआणपा लख होहि त इक न चलै नालि ॥
lines.e: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

lines.g: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
lines.r: kiv sachiaaraa hoieeaai kiv kooRai tuTai paal ||
lines.ht: किव सचिआरा होईऐ किव कूड़ै तुटै पालि ॥
lines.e: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of falsehood be torn away?

lines.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.r: hukam rajaiee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||
lines.ht: हुकमि रजाई चलणा नानक लिखिआ नालि ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

lines.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.r: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaiee ||
lines.ht: हुकमी होवनि आकार हुकमु न कहिआ जाई ॥
lines.e: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

lines.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.r: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaiee ||
lines.ht: हुकमी होवनि जीअ हुकमि मिलै वडिआई ॥
lines.e: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

lines.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
lines.r: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paie'eeh ||
lines.ht: हुकमी उतमु नीचु हुकमि लिखि दुख सुख पाईअहि ॥
lines.e: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

lines.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
lines.r: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadhaa bhavaie'eeh ||
lines.ht: इकना हुकमी बखसीस इकि हुकमी सदा भवाईअहि ॥
lines.e: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

lines.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koi ||
lines.ht: हुकमै अंदरि सभु को बाहरि हुकम न कोइ ॥
lines.e: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koi ||2||
lines.ht: नानक हुकमै जे बुझै त हउमै कहै न कोइ ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

lines.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||
lines.ht: गावै को ताणु होवै किसै ताणु ॥
lines.e: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?
Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.
Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.
Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

lines.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.r: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||
lines.ht: गावै को साजि करे तनु खेह ॥
lines.e: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

lines.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.r: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||
lines.ht: गावै को जीअ लै फिरि देह ॥
lines.e: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.
Some sing that He seems so very far away.
Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.
There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

lines.g: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
lines.r: kath kath kathee koTee koT koT ||
lines.ht: कथि कथि कथी कोटी कोटि कोटि ॥
lines.e: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.
The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.
Throughout the ages, consumers consume.
The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.
O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

lines.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: saachaa saahib saach nai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||
lines.ht: साचा साहिबु साचु नाइ भाखिआ भाउ अपारु ॥
lines.e: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

lines.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: aakheh ma(n)geh dheh dheh dhaat kare dhaataar ||
lines.ht: आखहि मंगहि देहि देहि दाति करे दातारु ॥
lines.e: People beg and pray, ""Give to us, give to us"", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

lines.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: fer k agai rakheeaai jit dhisai dharabaar ||
lines.ht: फेरि कि अगै रखीऐ जितु दिसै दरबारु ॥
lines.e: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

lines.g: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.r: muhau k bolan boleeaai jit sun dhare piaar ||
lines.ht: मुहौ कि बोलणु बोलीऐ जितु सुणि धरे पिआरु ॥
lines.e: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

lines.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: a(n)mirat velaa sach naau vaddiaaiee veechaar ||
lines.ht: अंमृत वेला सचु नाउ वडिआई वीचारु ॥
lines.e: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

lines.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.r: karamee aavai kapaRaa nadharee mokh dhuaar ||
lines.ht: करमी आवै कपड़ा नदरी मोखु दुआरु ॥
lines.e: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh aape sachiaar ||4||
lines.ht: नानक एवै जाणीऐ सभु आपे सचिआरु ॥४॥
lines.e: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

lines.g: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: thaapiaa na jai keetaa na hoi ||
lines.ht: थापिआ न जाइ कीता न होइ ॥
lines.e: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.
He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.
Those who serve Him are honored.
O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

lines.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: dhukh parahar sukh ghar lai jai ||
lines.ht: दुखु परहरि सुखु घरि लै जाइ ॥
lines.e: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.

lines.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.r: gurmukh naadha(n) gurmukh vedha(n) gurmukh rahiaa samaiee ||
lines.ht: गुरमुखि नादं गुरमुखि वेदं गुरमुखि रहिआ समाई ॥
lines.e: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.

lines.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.r: gur ieesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maiee ||
lines.ht: गुरु ईसरु गुरु गोरखु बरमा गुरु पारबती माई ॥
lines.e: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.r: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
lines.ht: जे हउ जाणा आखा नाही कहणा कथनु न जाई ॥
lines.e: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.
The Guru has given me this one understanding:

lines.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.r: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||5||
lines.ht: सभना जीआ का इकु दाता सो मै विसरि न जाई ॥५॥
lines.e: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

lines.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.r: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane k nai karee ||
lines.ht: तीरथि नावा जे तिसु भावा विणु भाणे कि नाइ करी ॥
lines.e: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

lines.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
lines.r: jetee siraTh upaiee vekhaa vin karamaa k milai liee ||
lines.ht: जेती सिरठि उपाई वेखा विणु करमा कि मिलै लई ॥
lines.e: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

lines.g: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
lines.r: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee ||
lines.ht: मति विचि रतन जवाहर माणिक जे इक गुर की सिख सुणी ॥
lines.e: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.
The Guru has given me this one understanding:

lines.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.r: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||6||
lines.ht: सभना जीआ का इकु दाता सो मै विसरि न जाई ॥६॥
lines.e: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

lines.g: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dhasoonee hoi ||
lines.ht: जे जुग चारे आरजा होर दसूणी होइ ॥
lines.e: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

lines.g: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: navaa kha(n)ddaa vich jaaneeaai naal chalai sabh koi ||
lines.ht: नवा खंडा विचि जाणीऐ नालि चलै सभु कोइ ॥
lines.e: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

lines.g: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.r: cha(n)gaa naau rakhai kai jas keerat jag lei ||
lines.ht: चंगा नाउ रखाइ कै जसु कीरति जगि लेइ ॥
lines.e: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

lines.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
lines.r: je tis nadhar na aaviee ta vaat na puchhai ke ||
lines.ht: जे तिसु नदरि न आवई त वात न पुछै के ॥
lines.e: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

lines.g: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.r: keeTaa a(n)dhar keeT kar dhosee dhos dhare ||
lines.ht: कीटा अंदरि कीटु करि दोसी दोसु धरे ॥
lines.e: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
lines.r: naanak niragun gun kare gunava(n)tiaa gun dhe ||
lines.ht: नानक निरगुणि गुणु करे गुणवंतिआ गुणु दे ॥
lines.e: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

lines.g: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.r: tehaa koi na sujhiee j tis gun koi kare ||7||
lines.ht: तेहा कोइ न सुझई जि तिसु गुणु कोइ करे ॥७॥
lines.e: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||
Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.
Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.
Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.
Listening-Death cannot even touch you.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||
Listening-Shiva, Brahma and Indra.
Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.
Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.
Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||
Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.
Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||
Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.
Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.
Listening-even the blind find the Path.
Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

lines.g: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: ma(n)ne kee gat kahee na jai ||
lines.ht: मंने की गति कही न जाइ ॥
lines.e: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.
No paper, no pen, no scribe
can record the state of the faithful.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.r: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||12||
lines.ht: जे को मंनि जाणै मनि कोइ ॥१२॥
lines.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||
The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
The faithful know about all worlds and realms.
The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

lines.g: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: ma(n)nai jam kai saath na jai ||
lines.ht: मंनै जम कै साथि न जाइ ॥
lines.e: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.r: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||13||
lines.ht: जे को मंनि जाणै मनि कोइ ॥१३॥
lines.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||
The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.
The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.
The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.r: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||14||
lines.ht: जे को मंनि जाणै मनि कोइ ॥१४॥
lines.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||
The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.
The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.
The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.r: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||15||
lines.ht: जे को मंनि जाणै मनि कोइ ॥१५॥
lines.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||
The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.
The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.
No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,
the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.
The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;
this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.
One who understands this becomes truthful.
What a great load there is on the bull!
So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: tis te bhaar talai kavan jor ||
lines.ht: तिस ते भारु तलै कवणु जोरु ॥
lines.e: What power holds them, and supports their weight?
The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings
were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.
Who knows how to write this account?
Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!
What power! What fascinating beauty!
And what gifts! Who can know their extent?
You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!
Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
lines.ht: जो तुधु भावै साई भली कार ॥
lines.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||
Countless meditations, countless loves.
Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.
Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.
Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.
Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.
Countless the holy, countless the givers.
Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).
Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
lines.ht: जो तुधु भावै साई भली कार ॥
lines.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||
Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.
Countless thieves and embezzlers.
Countless impose their will by force.
Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.
Countless sinners who keep on sinning.
Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.
Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.
Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
lines.ht: जो तुधु भावै साई भली कार ॥
lines.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||
Countless names, countless places.
Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.
Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.
From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.
From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.
From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.
From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

lines.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: jin eh likhe tis sir naeh ||
lines.ht: जिनि एहि लिखे तिसु सिरि नाहि ॥
lines.e: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.
As He ordains, so do we receive.
The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.
Without Your Name, there is no place at all.
How can I describe Your Creative Power?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
lines.ht: जो तुधु भावै साई भली कार ॥
lines.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||
When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
water can wash away the dirt.
When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,
soap can wash them clean.
But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,
it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.
Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.r: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu ||
lines.ht: करि करि करणा लिखि लै जाहु ॥
lines.e: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.
You shall harvest what you plant.
O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||
Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: je ko paavai til kaa maan ||
lines.ht: जे को पावै तिल का मानु ॥
lines.e: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.
Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,
cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

lines.g: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sabh gun tere mai naahee koi ||
lines.ht: सभि गुण तेरे मै नाही कोइ ॥
lines.e: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.

lines.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: vin gun keete bhagat na hoi ||
lines.ht: विणु गुण कीते भगति न होइ ॥
lines.e: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.
He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

lines.g: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: kavanu su velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar ||
lines.ht: कवणु सु वेला वखतु कवणु कवण थिति कवणु वारु ॥
lines.e: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?

lines.g: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: kavan s rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar ||
lines.ht: कवणि सि रुती माहु कवणु जितु होआ आकारु ॥
lines.e: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?

lines.g: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: vel na paieeaa pa(n)ddatee j hovai lekh puraan ||
lines.ht: वेल न पाईआ पंडती जि होवै लेखु पुराणु ॥
lines.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.

lines.g: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: vakhat na paio kaadheeaa j likhan lekh kuraan ||
lines.ht: वखतु न पाइओ कादीआ जि लिखनि लेखु कुराणु ॥
lines.e: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

lines.g: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.r: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koiee ||
lines.ht: थिति वारु ना जोगी जाणै रुति माहु ना कोई ॥
lines.e: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.r: jaa karataa siraThee kau saaje aape jaanai soiee ||
lines.ht: जा करता सिरठी कउ साजे आपे जाणै सोई ॥
lines.e: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.

lines.g: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.r: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiau varanee kiv jaanaa ||
lines.ht: किव करि आखा किव सालाही किउ वरनी किव जाणा ॥
lines.e: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.r: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik dhoo ik siaanaa ||
lines.ht: नानक आखणि सभु को आखै इक दू इकु सिआणा ॥
lines.e: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.

lines.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.r: vaddaa saahib vaddee naiee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
lines.ht: वडा साहिबु वडी नाई कीता जा का होवै ॥
lines.e: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.r: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai giaa na sohai ||21||
lines.ht: नानक जे को आपौ जाणै अगै गइआ न सोहै ॥२१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||
There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

lines.g: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
lines.r: oRak oRak bhaal thake vedh kahan ik vaat ||
lines.ht: ओड़क ओड़क भालि थके वेद कहनि इक वात ॥
lines.e: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

lines.g: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.r: sahas aThaareh kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||
lines.ht: सहस अठारह कहनि कतेबा असुलू इकु धातु ॥
lines.e: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

lines.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.r: lekhaa hoi ta likheeaai lekhai hoi vinaas ||
lines.ht: लेखा होइ त लिखीऐ लेखै होइ विणासु ॥
lines.e: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
lines.r: naanak vaddaa aakheeaai aape jaanai aap ||22||
lines.ht: नानक वडा आखीऐ आपे जाणै आपु ॥२२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

lines.g: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.r: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paieeaa ||
lines.ht: सालाही सालाहि एती सुरति न पाईआ ॥
lines.e: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

lines.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
lines.r: nadheeaa atai vaeh paveh samu(n)dh na jaane'eeh ||
lines.ht: नदीआ अतै वाह पवहि समुँदि न जाणीअहि ॥
lines.e: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

lines.g: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
lines.r: samu(n)dh saeh sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||
lines.ht: समुँद साह सुलतान गिरहा सेती मालु धनु ॥
lines.e: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

lines.g: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
lines.r: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh ||23||
lines.ht: कीड़ी तुलि न होवनी जे तिसु मनहु न वीसरहि ॥२३॥
lines.e: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

lines.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.r: a(n)t na sifatee kahan na a(n)t ||
lines.ht: अंतु न सिफती कहणि न अंतु ॥
lines.e: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

lines.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.r: a(n)t na karanai dhen na a(n)t ||
lines.ht: अंतु न करणै देणि न अंतु ॥
lines.e: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

lines.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.r: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||
lines.ht: अंतु न वेखणि सुणणि न अंतु ॥
lines.e: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

lines.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.r: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||
lines.ht: अंतु न जापै किआ मनि मंतु ॥
lines.e: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?
The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.
Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.
Many struggle to know His limits,

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaeh ||
lines.ht: ता के अंत न पाए जाहि ॥
lines.e: but His limits cannot be found.
No one can know these limits.
The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.
Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.
Highest of the High, above all is His Name.
Only one as Great and as High as God
can know His Lofty and Exalted State.
Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.
O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||
His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
The Great Giver does not hold back anything.
There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.
So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.
So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.
So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.
So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.
So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.
Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!
Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.
No one else has any say in this.
If some fool should presume to say that he does,
he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.
He Himself knows, He Himself gives.
Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.
One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,
O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||
Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.
Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.
Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.
Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.
Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.
Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.
Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.
Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.
Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!
Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.
The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.
The scholars speak and lecture.
Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.
The Gopis and Krishna speak.
Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.
The many created Buddhas speak.
The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

lines.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.r: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev ||
lines.ht: आखहि सुरि नर मुनि जन सेव ॥
lines.e: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.
Many speak and try to describe Him.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: kete keh keh uTh uTh jaeh ||
lines.ht: केते कहि कहि उठि उठि जाहि ॥
lines.e: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.
If He were to create as many again as there already are,

lines.g: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
lines.r: taa aakh na sakeh keiee kei ||
lines.ht: ता आखि न सकहि केई केइ ॥
lines.e: even then, they could not describe Him.
He is as Great as He wishes to be.
O Nanak, the True Lord knows.
If anyone presumes to describe God,
he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

lines.g: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.r: so dhar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
lines.ht: सो दरु केहा सो घरु केहा जितु बहि सरब समाले ॥
lines.e: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

lines.g: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: vaaje naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||
lines.ht: वाजे नाद अनेक असंखा केते वावणहारे ॥
lines.e: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||
lines.ht: केते राग परी सिउ कहीअनि केते गावणहारे ॥
lines.e: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि तुहनो पउणु पाणी बैसंतरु गावै राजा धरमु दुआरे ॥
lines.e: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि चितु गुपतु लिखि जाणहि लिखि लिखि धरमु वीचारे ॥
lines.e: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh ieesar baramaa dhevee sohan sadhaa savaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि ईसरु बरमा देवी सोहनि सदा सवारे ॥
lines.e: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh i(n)dh idhaasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
lines.ht: गावहि इंद इदासणि बैठे देवतिआ दरि नाले ॥
lines.e: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan saadh vichaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि सिध समाधी अंदरि गावनि साध विचारे ॥
lines.e: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaaveh veer karaare ||
lines.ht: गावनि जती सती संतोखी गावहि वीर करारे ॥
lines.e: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.r: gaavan pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedhaa naale ||
lines.ht: गावनि पंडित पड़नि रखीसर जुगु जुगु वेदा नाले ॥
lines.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh piaale ||
lines.ht: गावहि मोहणीआ मनु मोहनि सुरगा मछ पइआले ॥
lines.e: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.r: gaavan ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
lines.ht: गावनि रतन उपाए तेरे अठसठि तीरथ नाले ॥
lines.e: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि जोध महाबल सूरा गावहि खाणी चारे ॥
lines.e: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

lines.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: gaaveh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||
lines.ht: गावहि खंड मंडल वरभंडा करि करि रखे धारे ॥
lines.e: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

lines.g: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
lines.r: seiee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
lines.ht: सेई तुधुनो गावहि जो तुधु भावनि रते तेरे भगत रसाले ॥
lines.e: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

lines.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||
lines.ht: होरि केते गावनि से मै चिति न आवनि नानकु किआ वीचारे ॥
lines.e: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

lines.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.r: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
lines.ht: सोई सोई सदा सचु साहिबु साचा साची नाई ॥
lines.e: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

lines.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
lines.r: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
lines.ht: है भी होसी जाइ न जासी रचना जिनि रचाई ॥
lines.e: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

lines.g: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
lines.r: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
lines.ht: रंगी रंगी भाती करि करि जिनसी माइआ जिनि उपाई ॥
lines.e: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.r: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
lines.ht: करि करि वेखै कीता आपणा जिव तिस दी वडिआई ॥
lines.e: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.r: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
lines.ht: जो तिसु भावै सोई करसी हुकमु न करणा जाई ॥
lines.e: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

lines.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
lines.r: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||27||
lines.ht: सो पातिसाहु साहा पातिसाहिबु नानक रहणु रजाई ॥२७॥
lines.e: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

lines.g: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
lines.r: mu(n)dhaa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot ||
lines.ht: मुँदा संतोखु सरमु पतु झोली धिआन की करहि बिभूति ॥
lines.e: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

lines.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaiaa jugat dda(n)ddaa parateet ||
lines.ht: खिंथा कालु कुआरी काइआ जुगति डंडा परतीति ॥
lines.e: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

lines.g: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
lines.r: aaiee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||
lines.ht: आई पंथी सगल जमाती मनि जीतै जगु जीतु ॥
lines.e: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.
I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.r: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||
lines.ht: आदि अनीलु अनादि अनाहति जुगु जुगु एको वेसु ॥२८॥
lines.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

lines.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
lines.r: bhugat giaan dhiaa bha(n)ddaaran ghaT ghaT vaajeh naadh ||
lines.ht: भुगति गिआनु दइआ भंडारणि घटि घटि वाजहि नाद ॥
lines.e: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

lines.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
lines.r: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saadh ||
lines.ht: आपि नाथु नाथी सभ जा की रिधि सिधि अवरा साद ॥
lines.e: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

lines.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)jog vijog dhui kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag ||
lines.ht: संजोगु विजोगु दुइ कार चलावहि लेखे आवहि भाग ॥
lines.e: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.
I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.r: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||
lines.ht: आदि अनीलु अनादि अनाहति जुगु जुगु एको वेसु ॥२९॥
lines.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

lines.g: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: ekaa maiee jugat viaaiee tin chele paravaan ||
lines.ht: एका माई जुगति विआई तिनि चेले परवाणु ॥
lines.e: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

lines.g: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: eik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)ddaaree ik laae dheebaan ||
lines.ht: इकु संसारी इकु भंडारी इकु लाए दीबाणु ॥
lines.e: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

lines.g: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan ||
lines.ht: जिव तिसु भावै तिवै चलावै जिव होवै फुरमाणु ॥
lines.e: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

lines.g: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
lines.r: oh vekhai onaa nadhar na aavai bahutaa eh viddaan ||
lines.ht: ओहु वेखै ओना नदरि न आवै बहुता एहु विडाणु ॥
lines.e: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!
I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
lines.r: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||
lines.ht: आदि अनीलु अनादि अनाहति जुगु जुगु एको वेसु ॥३०॥
lines.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||
On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jo kichh paiaa su ekaa vaar ||
lines.ht: जो किछु पाइआ सु एका वार ॥
lines.e: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.
Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.
O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.
I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
lines.r: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||
lines.ht: आदि अनीलु अनादि अनाहति जुगु जुगु एको वेसु ॥३१॥
lines.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

lines.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
lines.r: eik dhoo jeebhau lakh hoh lakh hoveh lakh vees ||
lines.ht: इक दू जीभौ लख होहि लख होवहि लख वीस ॥
lines.e: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

lines.g: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
lines.r: lakh lakh geRaa aakhe'eeh ek naam jagadhees ||
lines.ht: लखु लखु गेड़ा आखीअहि एकु नामु जगदीस ॥
lines.e: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.g: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
lines.r: et raeh pat pavaReeaa chaReeaai hoi ikees ||
lines.ht: एतु राहि पति पवड़ीआ चड़ीऐ होइ इकीस ॥
lines.e: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

lines.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
lines.r: sun galaa aakaas kee keeTaa aaiee rees ||
lines.ht: सुणि गला आकास की कीटा आई रीस ॥
lines.e: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
lines.r: naanak nadharee paieeaai kooRee kooRai Thees ||32||
lines.ht: नानक नदरी पाईऐ कूड़ी कूड़ै ठीस ॥३२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||
No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

lines.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: jor na ma(n)gan dhen na jor ||
lines.ht: जोरु न मंगणि देणि न जोरु ॥
lines.e: No power to beg, no power to give.

lines.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: jor na jeevan maran neh jor ||
lines.ht: जोरु न जीवणि मरणि नह जोरु ॥
lines.e: No power to live, no power to die.

lines.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: jor na raaj maal man sor ||
lines.ht: जोरु न राजि मालि मनि सोरु ॥
lines.e: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.
No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.
No power to find the way to escape from the world.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||
lines.ht: जिसु हथि जोरु करि वेखै सोइ ॥
lines.e: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.
O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||
Nights, days, weeks and seasons;
wind, water, fire and the nether regions

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
lines.r: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||
lines.ht: तिसु विचि धरती थापि रखी धरम साल ॥
lines.e: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.r: tis vich jeea jugat ke ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: तिसु विचि जीअ जुगति के रंग ॥
lines.e: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.
Their names are uncounted and endless.
By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.
God Himself is True, and True is His Court.
There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.
They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.
The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.
O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||
This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.
And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
lines.r: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||
lines.ht: केते पवण पाणी वैसंतर केते कान महेस ॥
lines.e: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.r: kete barame ghaaRat ghaRe'eh roop ra(n)g ke ves ||
lines.ht: केते बरमे घाड़ति घड़ीअहि रूप रंग के वेस ॥
lines.e: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
lines.r: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upadhes ||
lines.ht: केतीआ करम भूमी मेर केते केते धू उपदेस ॥
lines.e: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
lines.r: kete i(n)dh cha(n)dh soor kete kete ma(n)ddal dhes ||
lines.ht: केते इंद चंद सूर केते केते मंडल देस ॥
lines.e: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.r: kete sidh budh naath kete kete dhevee ves ||
lines.ht: केते सिध बुध नाथ केते केते देवी वेस ॥
lines.e: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
lines.r: kete dhev dhaanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)dh ||
lines.ht: केते देव दानव मुनि केते केते रतन समुँद ॥
lines.e: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
lines.r: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)dh ||
lines.ht: केतीआ खाणी केतीआ बाणी केते पात नरिंद ॥
lines.e: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

lines.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.r: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||
lines.ht: केतीआ सुरती सेवक केते नानक अंतु न अंतु ॥३५॥
lines.e: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||
In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.
The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.
In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaeh ||
lines.ht: ता कीआ गला कथीआ ना जाहि ॥
lines.e: These things cannot be described.
One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

lines.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.r: tithai ghaReeaai surat mat man budh ||
lines.ht: तिथै घड़ीऐ सुरति मति मनि बुधि ॥
lines.e: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

lines.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
lines.r: tithai ghaReeaai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
lines.ht: तिथै घड़ीऐ सुरा सिधा की सुधि ॥३६॥
lines.e: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
No one else dwells there,
except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.
They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh ||
lines.ht: ता के रूप न कथने जाहि ॥
lines.e: Their beauty cannot be described.

lines.g: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: naa oh mareh na Thaage jaeh ||
lines.ht: ना ओहि मरहि न ठागे जाहि ॥
lines.e: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

lines.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: jin kai raam vasai man maeh ||
lines.ht: जिन कै रामु वसै मन माहि ॥
lines.e: within whose minds the Lord abides.
The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.r: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
lines.ht: जे को कथै त अंत न अंत ॥
lines.e: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

lines.g: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
lines.ht: जिव जिव हुकमु तिवै तिव कार ॥
lines.e: As He commands, so they exist.
He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,
and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

lines.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jin kau nadhar karam tin kaar ||
lines.ht: जिन कउ नदरि करमु तिन कार ॥
lines.e: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.
O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
lines.r: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
lines.ht: पवणु गुरू पाणी पिता माता धरति महतु ॥
lines.e: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

lines.g: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
lines.r: dhivas raat dhui dhaiee dhaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
lines.ht: दिवसु राति दुइ दाई दाइआ खेलै सगल जगतु ॥
lines.e: Day and night are each like the nanny and her caregiving husband, in whose lap the whole world is at play.
Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

lines.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.r: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||
lines.ht: करमी आपो आपणी के नेड़ै के दूरि ॥
lines.e: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

lines.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
lines.r: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||
lines.ht: जिनी नामु धिआइआ गए मसकति घालि ॥
lines.e: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhuTee naal ||1||
lines.ht: नानक ते मुख उजले केती छुटी नालि ॥१॥
lines.e: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||
